item.title: Eric Dane, 'Grey's Anatomy' and 'Euphoria' star, dead at 53
item.description: Eric Dane, the celebrated actor best known for his roles on “Grey’s Anatomy” and “Euphoria” and who later in life became advocate for ALS awareness, died Thursday. He was 53.

item.title: Memorial services for Rev. Jesse Jackson expanded to include South Carolina, Washington, DC
item.description: Memorial services honoring the life of the Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr. will be expanded beyond Chicago with events in Washington, D.C., and South Carolina, the late civil rights leader's organization announced Thursday.

item.title: Youth programs at Pickens County libraries canceled until further notice
item.description: The Pickens County Library System will cancel dozens of youth programs starting Feb. 23, after a board voted to implement a new collections policy that restricts certain content for minors.
